ns2:course.label: Adolescent Development
ns2:course.description: Examines paths of experience and individual development within the family, the peer group, and other domains through this socially-defined stage of life. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: HDFS 105 and PSYC 100.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: HDFS 105 and PSYC 100.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
